newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar futures lifted by fund buying.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar futures lifted by fund buying.

text.p: Fund buying on the CSCE raws market turned round LIFFE's white sugar futures in late trading from a minor deficit to a $4.60 gain on the day.
The New York March climbed to a five-month high as anticipated buy stops at over 11 cents/lb were struck bringing the funds into a market where sellers were reluctant, dealers said.
At the LIFFE close the May white contract was up $4.60 at $312.10, the day's high and Aug was $4.20 ahead at $311.30.
Volume totalled 2,106 lots on May and 302 on August.
The CSCE March raws was up 0.34 cents at 11.26 cents, just off a 11.30 high reached on September 24.
In Paris the May contract finished up $2.50 at the day's high of $308.50 and Aug was $0.80 firmer at $306.80.
